excerpt: Terminating these NIH grants isn't efficiency—it's sabotage. My lab's cystic fibrosis work just lost 3 years of progress. Patients will die sooner because of this administration's ignorance.
The HHS leadership is dismantling the very infrastructure that made American biomedical research the envy of the world. These cuts will harm patients and cede our leadership to China.
Mr. Chairman, the arbitrary termination of 2,400 active grants is not reform—it is a unilateral assault on peer review and on the constitutional role of Congress to appropriate funds.
Just got word that our community-based diabetes prevention trial in rural Texas is cancelled. This administration is waging war on science that doesn't fit their political agenda.
I've never seen morale this low. Young researchers are leaving the field because they see the NIH budget being gutted for tax cuts. These cuts will harm patients for a generation.
The immigration enforcement raids on our campuses are not a 'security measure'—they are authoritarian intimidation designed to silence scientific exchange. We stand with our international colleagues.
I will not be silent while HHS leadership dismantles the very agencies that funded the vaccines, the cancer treatments, and the clean water we all rely on. This is a moral line.
They call it 'reorganization'. I call it a brain drain. Senior NIH scientists are being pushed out for loyalty tests. This is not governance; it's a purge.
Joining the March for Science in DC next week. If this administration won't listen to researchers, they will have to listen to voters. #ScienceIsNotPolitical
The grant terminations are not based on merit—they are based on whether your topic mentions 'climate' or 'health equity'. This administration is waging war on science itself.
I've spent 20 years studying Alzheimer's biomarkers. Now my federal funding is gone because of a political litmus test. My patients don't have time for this nonsense.
Protest at HHS HQ today. We are not 'wasteful bureaucrats'—we are the people who stopped the last pandemic. This is authoritarianism, plain and simple.
The immigration enforcement actions have made it impossible for my students to travel to international conferences. This is a direct attack on scientific progress and the American dream.
Our phase 2 trial of a novel CRISPR-based therapy for sickle cell disease shows a 78% reduction in vaso-occlusive crises over 12 months. We are expanding to phase 3.
We report a new class of solid-state electrolyte that achieves 10x higher ionic conductivity at room temperature, enabling safer, faster-charging batteries for EVs.
Our model reduces transformer inference cost by 40% while maintaining 99% of accuracy on GLUE benchmarks, with implications for on-device AI.
Preliminary data from our longitudinal cohort (n=12,000) suggests that maternal vitamin D supplementation reduces childhood asthma incidence by 23% at age 6.
We've built a low-cost, solar-powered water desalination unit that produces 20 liters/hour for under $100 in materials—a game-changer for drought-prone regions.
Dr. Rodriguez is honored to receive the 2025 Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Research Excellence Award for her pioneering work on protein misfolding inhibitors.
Dr. Okafor was named a Fellow of the American Physical Society for his contributions to quantum error correction, the highest honor in the field.
Our team's research on coral reef restoration is now featured in an NSF-funded documentary series, showcasing how science can drive conservation.
Excited to share that our agricultural genomics project received a new round of private foundation funding—we can continue breeding drought-resistant maize independently. Science will find a way.
